parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: authentication-order
parameters.explanation: 认证顺序，'none'表示不进行认证。

set system authorization network default.command: set system authorization network default local

parameters.name: network
parameters.explanation: 网络授权方式，'default'表示默认方式。

set access address-assignment pool local.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet network [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool local.command: set access address-assignment pool local family inet network 172.16.0.0/16
set access address-assignment pool local.explanation: 配置地址分配池的网络地址及子网掩码。

set access address-assignment pool local.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet default-router [parameter2]
set access address-assignment pool local.command: set access address-assignment pool local family inet default-router 172.16.0.1
set access address-assignment pool local.explanation: 配置地址分配池的默认路由器。

set access address-assignment pool ipv4.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet range [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set access address-assignment pool ipv4.command: set access address-assignment pool ipv4 family inet range 10.0.0.1 to 10.0.0.254
set access address-assignment pool ipv4.explanation: 配置地址分配池的IP地址范围。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
